entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A leader of Ravnica who speaks of justice and of taking back land, and who instructs Gideon Jura to fight among the rank and file.

entities.name: Nefara
entities.description: A Dimir agent who watched an unblinking guard from the shadows.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild of Ravnica whose insignia is seen only by its members and the doomed; a guild of spies, lies and deception.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Aurelia tested among the rank and file.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose symbol is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

entities.name: Alovnek
entities.description: A Boros guildmage who wants justice now.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild with an army of soldiers, skyknights and mage-priests.

entities.name: Zunak
entities.description: A Selesnya strategist.

entities.name: Klattic
entities.description: A Boros legionnaire who was made hollow so a blade passed through him.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A religious guild of Ravnica that collects debts and shackles souls.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnica's guild of law, the seat of justice and foundation of Ravnican society.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: A sheltering power invoked by a Selesnya speaker.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A former Azorius figure who told Jace Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously.

entities.name: Lodusz
entities.description: A captain of the watch.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: A distinguished advokist who boasts of tying the law into knots.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: A schemer who speaks to Lazav and Isperia about the guilds, and whose family runs to ambition.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir figure with intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

entities.name: Gateless Movement
entities.description: A movement to which Boros is reportedly losing its angels.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A figure who craves the sphinxes' wisdom but can't tolerate their secrecy.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A planeswalker who transmuted an Eternal into a frog-like creature.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Invading undead creatures on Ravnica, some airborne.

entities.name: Zelzo Base
entities.description: A place with a grate opened by one of a rogue's keys.

entities.name: Ismeri Library
entities.description: A library for which a rogue holds a key.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who would send the sea after fleeing enemies.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of laboratories, chronarchs and mages who specialize in unnatural disaster.

entities.name: Yolov
entities.description: A Simic bioengineer.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of biological innovation whose sigil serves as a trademark.

entities.name: Minosz
entities.description: The Orzhov chief of security.

entities.name: Agosto
entities.description: An Azorius imperator.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A performer who delights in performance and directs the stage.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A speaker who compares people's treasures to rats' hoards.

entities.name: Ivrelya
entities.description: A Dimir spymaster who threatens a Legion captive.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer whose command a feline Eternal disdained.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A Golgari necromancer who speaks of the rhythm of necromancy and the circle of life and death.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane of the guilds.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A killer with a rising bounty and many imitators.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of cultists and deadly shows that sow chaos.

entities.name: Juri Revue
entities.description: A Rakdos show venue whose star performer is a bloodthirsty giant.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Ravnica's wild guild of rage and territorial markings.

entities.name: Kroshkar
entities.description: A Gruul shaman.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who sees countless worlds.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin mob boss with loyal hirelings and a perverse charisma fueled by avarice.

entities.name: Nedja
entities.description: A Gruul shaman.

entities.name: Blunk
entities.description: One whose blunt response won an argument against a lawmage.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker fighting to stop a tyrant.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnica's guild of the cycle of life and death; the Street Swarm is its labor class.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: A Simic figure of the Hull Clade.

entities.name: Hull Clade
entities.description: A Simic clade.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Golgari shaman.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: One to whom Teysa warns that the Selesnya are gathering armies.

entities.name: Tamina
entities.description: A district guide.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A speaker who relishes meat and eggs.

entities.name: Yeva
entities.description: Nature's Herald, who can call an army in the blink of an eye.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: A Boros figure who advises recruits to hold to ideals and challenges Aurelia's talk of peace.

entities.name: Lyzolda
entities.description: Owner of pet rats that eat citizens.

entities.name: Barvisa
entities.description: A courtroom scribe.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: Ravnica's hungry underground.

entities.name: Veszka
entities.description: A Selesnya evangel.

entities.name: Ezoc
entities.description: A Golgari rot farmer.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: A speaker proud of marching legions and skyknights.

entities.name: Pesha
entities.description: A retired blacksmith.

entities.name: Uncle Dragi
entities.description: Pesha's uncle, whose head is now used by a slitherhead.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A speaker who describes the weight of a Boros signet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The figure whose vanity portrait the Izzet signet increasingly resembles.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who prefers guilds to contend with words rather than swords.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact that in theory keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control.

entities.name: Dravin
entities.description: A Gruul deserter who wept at the idiocy of war.

entities.name: Fblthp
entities.description: One who had always hated crowds.

entities.name: The Cozen
entities.description: An Orzhov assassin.

entities.name: Agmand Sarv
entities.description: An Azorius hussar.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker whose unlikely ascent some see as a sign of Ilharg's return.

entities.name: Ilharg, the Raze-Boar
entities.description: A being whose imminent return some foresee.

entities.name: Quyzl
entities.description: A student told by his mentor to make more time for his studies.

entities.name: Mizzix
entities.description: A speaker who appreciates things that exceed expectations.

entities.name: Leonos
entities.description: An official who enacted an abolishment edict.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who vows to protect those he can.

entities.name: The Absolution of the Guildpact
entities.description: A play whose third act was rewritten as a tragedy amid rumors of war.

entities.name: Karlov
entities.description: A member of the Ghost Council who is aware of Teysa's scheming.

events.summary: Dimir agents including Nefara watch an unblinking guard for eight hours and decide to find another way in.
events.quote: "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed.

events.summary: Aurelia tells Gideon Jura he must first fight among the rank and file.
events.quote: "First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader." —Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

events.summary: Teysa tells Lazav that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.
events.quote: "I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

events.summary: Kasmina transforms an Eternal and sends it hopping away.
events.quote: "Hop away now, little Eternal. Go eat some flies." —Kasmina

events.summary: Lazav reports intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.
events.quote: "We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

events.summary: A feline Eternal disdains Liliana's command and scampers away.
events.quote: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

events.summary: Teysa warns Isperia that the Selesnya are gathering armies.
events.quote: "The Selesnya are gathering armies. Do you still believe they aren't preparing for war?" —Teysa, to Isperia

events.summary: Giant sinkholes open across Ravnica, revealing buried oceans and merfolk thought extinct.
events.quote: When giant sinkholes opened across Ravnica, they revealed buried oceans and the merfolk, once thought to be extinct.

events.summary: Tajic confronts Aurelia over attacks and thefts, rejecting talk of peace.
events.quote: "Three daggers left in an angel's back, three enforcers with memory loss, three keys stolen from my own belt—and you talk of peace?" —Tajic, to Aurelia

events.summary: Lavinia recalls warning Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he neglected his responsibilities, and laments being right.
events.quote: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

events.summary: Domri rises unexpectedly, which some view as a sign of Ilharg's return.
events.quote: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

events.summary: Leonos issues an abolishment edict, warning of eviction with skyrunes on a cloudy day.
events.quote: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict.

events.summary: Amid rumors of war, the third act of The Absolution of the Guildpact is rewritten as a tragedy.
events.quote: Amid rumors of war, the third act of The *Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.
